cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(IndagoLiefCheck LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
if(MSVC)
  set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
endif()
get_filename_component(repo "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(WIN32)
  set(platform windows)
else()
  set(platform linux)
endif()
find_package(LIEF 1.0.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS STATIC
  PATHS "${repo}/out/lief-sdk/${platform}/lib/cmake/LIEF" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
add_executable(indago_lief_check main.cpp "${repo}/src/lief_worker.cpp" "${repo}/src/sha256.cpp")
target_include_directories(indago_lief_check PRIVATE "${repo}/include" "${repo}/vendor")
target_compile_definitions(indago_lief_check PRIVATE INDAGO_HAS_LIEF=1)
target_link_libraries(indago_lief_check PRIVATE LIEF::LIEF)
if(WIN32)
  enable_language(RC)
  add_executable(indago_resource_fixture "${repo}/tests/fixtures/enrichment/fixture.c" resource.rc)
  set_source_files_properties("${repo}/tests/fixtures/enrichment/fixture.c" PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CXX)
endif()
